calls.video_title: DraftKings Faces Increasing Competition in Prediction Markets | DKNG Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: Reiterated buying opportunity: forward PE ~12 prices in zero growth, but DKNG's own prediction-markets product is gaining share and is lower-risk to regulatory reversal than Polymarket/Kalshi.
calls.base_case: Updated DCF ~$31/share vs ~$20 price = significant undervaluation; near 52-week low.
calls.bull_case: If regulation tightens on prediction markets, DKNG's state-by-state position strengthens further.
calls.bear_case: Losing confidence in near-term execution; convincing investors on share retention will take longer.

calls.video_title: Why Is DraftKings Stock Crashing, and is it a Buying Opportunity? | DKNG Stock Near 52 Week Low
calls.thesis: Prediction markets flipped from headwind to growth driver (1M+ customers, millions expected by end of NFL season); wins in either regulatory outcome; forward P/E 11; DCF still attractive after raising beta for elevated risk. High-risk-tolerance investors only.
calls.bull: Prediction-market customer growth returns DraftKings to its growth trajectory.
calls.bear: Fiercest-ever competition, marketing spend pulled forward into 2026, regulatory uncertainty.
